summary: ATN International, Inc. subsidiaries completed the initial closing of a sale of tower portfolios to Everest Infrastructure Partners for up to $297 million in cash. At closing, $153.4 million was paid for Assigned Sites and $114.3 million for Managed Sites, with deferred sites to close later. The transaction was governed by a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated February 11, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed in the filing. The deal is structured as a staged asset sale with management agreements for sites not yet conveyed. Watch for subsequent closings of deferred sites and potential regulatory approvals affecting the timeline.
